intro: Use this convert grams into pounds calculator to convert g to lb accurately for recipes, meat portions, nutrition tracking, and postal parcels. Under the International Yard and Pound Agreement, 1 avoirdupois pound equals exactly 453.59237 grams, so dividing grams by 453.59237 (or multiplying by 0.00220462) returns the exact weight in pounds. Check common benchmarks—including 113.4 g for a quarter pound—in the table below.
alsoWrittenAs: g to lbs, gram to pound, grams into pounds, g into lb, metric grams to lb

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact 453.59237 g Divisor vs. Rounding & 'gr' Symbol
items: Using 454 g per pound instead of the exact 453.59237 g introduces roughly 0.09% error—small for home cooking, but noticeable across bulk inventory or laboratory tare weights.
In metrology and pharmacy, 'g' denotes grams while 'gr' denotes grains (1 grain = 64.79891 mg). Always check whether a datasheet means grams (g) before converting to pounds.

faqs.question: How many grams are in a quarter pound?
faqs.answer: There are 113.39809 grams (commonly rounded to 113.4 g) in a quarter pound (0.25 lb, or 4 oz), calculated as 453.59237 ÷ 4.

faqs.question: How many grams are in a pound of meat?
faqs.answer: One pound equals exactly 453.59237 grams (roughly 454 g), regardless of whether you are weighing raw meat, poultry, flour, or parcels.

faqs.question: How do I convert grams to pounds (g to lb)?
faqs.answer: Divide the weight in grams by 453.59237, or multiply by 0.00220462. For example, 380 g ÷ 453.59237 = 0.83776 lb.

faqs.question: How many pounds (lb) are in 1 gram (g)?
faqs.answer: One gram equals 0.00220462 pounds (0.002205 lb rounded to 6 decimal places). Conversely, 1 pound equals 453.59237 grams.
